precepts.text: The Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
precepts.point: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: we were called by other names, African American, Dominican, Negro, but now we are coming into the understanding that we are actually the children of Israel.

note.label: Deuteronomy 26: The Firstfruits Confession and a Peculiar People

precepts.why:
“And the Lord hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee”. The psalm says the same: “For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.”

The peculiar people avouched here is Jacob, Israel, chosen unto himself for his peculiar treasure.

precepts.text: He gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people; yet we are not in our homeland today.
precepts.point: These are the curses we are under. Our heritage, the heathens, became our masters and our oppressors today. We are still under the curses of God, disconnected from our blessings and from our homeland.

note.label: Psalm 127: Except the Lord Build the House

precepts.why: He “gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.” The land was our heritage, yet we are not in our homeland today. We have been disconnected from our heritage, from our blessings and from our homeland, under the curses of God.
